Anesthesia Bootcamp

Teaching pages for the OR.

Chalk talks, handouts and interactive explainers for residents, students and anyone learning anesthesia.

Get it on your phone

Add Anesthesia Bootcamp to your home screen. It opens like an app, and once you've opened it with signal, the talks list, papers and handout PDFs work offline (handy in the OR).

  • iPhone: open this page in Safari, tap the Share button (□↑), then Add to Home Screen.
  • Android: open this page in Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu, then Install app or Add to Home screen.
  • Computer: in Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the right end of the address bar.
